svg.title: A stereo pair as full side by side: the left eye's view first, then the right eye's, each complete
svg.desc: Two frames side by side, their centres 240 pixels apart so that the pair can be free-viewed with the eyes relaxed. In both, a square sits at the same place: it is on the screen. A circle is drawn further right in the left view and further left in the right view: it is popped, in front of the screen. A triangle is drawn further left in the left view and further right in the right view: it is sunk, behind the screen.
svg.text: square: on the screen, same place in both
circle: popped, shifted the opposite way in each eye
triangle: sunk, shifted the other way round
one picture: the left view first, then the right, each complete, each at its own size
